newsitem.title: INDIA: India Procter up 8.0 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: India Procter up 8.0 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of Indian personal products firm Procter & Gamble jumped 48 rupees or 8.0 percent to 648 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Wednesday after the firm announced improved results for the financial year ended June 30, traders said.

The firm said late on Tuesday its sales rose by 37 percent to 3.66 billion rupees for the year ended June 30, 1996. Profit after tax of 262 million rupees was 87 percent higher than the year ago figures, it said.
The Indian subsidiary of the U.S. consumer products giant said it planned to introduce new products in the near future.
